name: Diablo with Diablo 2 Movement
tagline: Diablo 1 through DevilutionX with Diablo 2's movement: walk straight to where you click, slide past corners and run in town.

games.label: Diablo
games.engine: DevilutionX 1.5.3 fork (C++, SDL2), Windows x64; reads your DIABDAT.MPQ
games.runtime: any Diablo with DIABDAT.MPQ (GOG, or the original CD); Hellfire MPQs optional

games.label: Diablo II
games.note: movement re-made from Diablo II 1.12's behaviour; Diablo II is not needed

source.upstream_license: Sustainable Use License 1.0 (non-commercial, free distribution only)

notes: How it works: you play Diablo 1 (through DevilutionX) with Diablo 2's movement: your hero walks straight to the exact point you click, slides past corners, and runs in town. Everything else plays like DevilutionX 1.5.3.

Pick the folder holding your DIABDAT.MPQ as the Diablo game folder. Press Play: the app starts devilutionx.exe from that folder (not Diablo.exe). DevilutionX reads your MPQs in place (Hellfire's too when present).

Click (or push the stick) to move. In town R toggles running and holding Left Ctrl does the opposite for a moment; in the dungeon everyone walks. Settings > Gameplay > "Diablo 2 Movement" off brings back Diablo 1's tile walking.
You need your own Diablo with DIABDAT.MPQ (GOG's Diablo, or the original CD copied to a folder). Hellfire also needs hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq and hfvoice.mpq. Diablo II is not needed.

Multiplayer only sees other players running this mod. Restore removes DevilutionX and puts back any file it replaced; your saves in %APPDATA%\diasurgical\devilution stay. Free, non-commercial license (Sustainable Use License 1.0).
Pre-release, a personal learning project: expect rough edges. The upstream repo has no issue tracker; bugs that also happen without the mod belong to DevilutionX.
